Report Description
***WEB REPORT*** WHILE FUELING 22' CENTER CONSOLE, ACCIDENTLY INSERTED THE FUEL NOZZLE INTO THE BOATS ROD HOLDER ADJACENT TO FILL PIPE. PUMPED APPROXIMATELY 30 GALLONS INTO BOAT BEFORE DISCOVERING MISTAKE. THE BILGE PUMP IN BOAT ACTIVATED AND DISCHARGED APPROXIMATELY 10 GALLONS OF GASOLINE INTO THE WATER. MARINA STAFF WERE NOTIFIED AND EMERGENCY SPILL PREVENTION PLAN WAS COMMENCED. SECURED AREA FROM ANY POSSIBLE IGNITION SOURCES. AUTOMATIC BILGE PUMP WAS MECHANICALLY DISABLED. BOOMS DEPLOYED TO CONTAIN GASOLINE . GASOLINE HAS EVAPORATED OFF SURFACE OF WATER. BOAT HAULED AND BALANCE OF GASOLINE IN BILGE RECOVERED
